sample_unit: anonymized German doctor's notes (from five patients)

links.outcome: Extraction accuracy (F1) against reference coding for medications and diagnoses
links.effect: Diagnosis F1 did not exceed 0.12 (0.18 for broad category); medication F1 up to 0.78, 0.95 for trivial name extraction.
links.quote: The F1 scores for diagnoses do not exceed 0.12.

unlisted_practices: RAG-based versus agentic LLM pipelines for clinical code mapping
Local open-weight LLM deployment on on-premises GPU for data extraction

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM and agentic pipelines for extracting and mapping clinical codes from retrospective unstructured clinical notes.
